text: On behalf of the Student Union, I am honored to extend a cordial invitation to you to serve as an expert judge for our upcoming 15th Campus English Speech Contest.
The event is scheduled to be held in the Grand Auditorium from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. next Friday, November 14th.
The contest will feature fifteen distinguished finalists delivering speeches on the theme of Cultural Interconnection in the Modern Era.

Considering your outstanding academic prestige and profound linguistic insight, your professional evaluation and commentary would undoubtedly inspire all contestants and elevate the academic caliber of this competition.
We would be deeply grateful if you could accept our invitation.
Please kindly notify us of your availability before this Wednesday.
